model.summary: Model favors DEN by 10.5 points (81% win chance). Biggest factors: Elo rating (DEN +5.0), Scoring margin (last 8 games) (DEN +1.7), Rest days (home minus away) (DEN +1.7). The baseline of +1.9 covers typical home-field advantage.

total_model.summary: Model projects 44.2 total points (DEN 27, LV 17). Biggest factors: Divisional game (lowers total 0.8), Combined quarterback ratings (lowers total 0.8), Combined offense EPA/play (recent-weighted) (raises total 0.7). The baseline of 45.7 is the typical NFL total in the training data.

qb_what_if.note: Approximate: swaps only the quarterback rating and the model's QB-change flag (a new starter counts as a change). Team offense and defense form stay as they are. A positive margin change favors the home team.
